newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Metacorp acquires British firm Precis.
newsitem.headline: Metacorp acquires British firm Precis.

text.p: Malaysia's Metacorp Bhd said on Wednesday it had acquired the entire issued and paid-up share capital of British firm Precis (1474) Ltd for 23.4 million sterling.

In a statement to the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange, the toll road operator and property developer said the purchase comprised two ordinary shares bought from County and District Properties Ltd (CDP), a unit of London-based Costain Group Plc.

As part of the deal, Precis has proposed to acquire a 33.3 percent stake in Spitalfields Holdings Ltd (SHL) by buying 100 ordinary shares and 10.418 million preference shares in SHL for 10.42 million sterling.
SHL is developing a site in London into an office, retail and residential complex, the statement said.

Precis has proposed to take over SHL's debt, comprising first loan notes of 43.77 million sterling and term loan of 50 million sterling. It also plans to buy a 33.3 percent interest in Spitalfields Development Group (SDG), a joint venture construction services firm.
Both SHL and SDG were units of CDP.
CDP will then subscribe to 80.79 million new deferred shares in Precis for 80.79 million sterling, the statement said.
